# Source685 display controllers

The manifest binds five exact historical Python sources. They retain their
external source-specific paths and immutable cases/plans; adapt only into a
new controller with its own hash and fresh output. The original636 archive
remains separate. Captures, keys, complete cases/plans/expected objects, exports,
images, binaries and logs are excluded. See the636/685 stage report for counts
and limitations. Do not reformat these byte-audited historical copies.
